title: Named Non-Owner Policy Fee Schedule
content:
**Fees on the Named Non-Owner Policy, all packages.** Every fee below is fully earned.

| Fee | Amount (USD) | When it arises |
|---|---|---|
| Policy fee, new business | 20.00 | on a new-business term |
| Policy fee, renewal | 10.00 | on an accepted renewal term |
| Reinstatement fee | 20.00 | for each reinstatement with a lapse |

The three amounts are the same on Cardinal Point Non-Owner Minimum Limits, Minimum Limits with UM, 50/100/50, 100/200/50, 100/300/50 and 250/500/100.

**Reading the schedule (hypothetical).** A term that is bought new and later reinstated once with a lapse carries a policy fee of 20.00 and one reinstatement fee of 20.00; the renewal term that follows it carries a policy fee of 10.00 once accepted. A reinstatement without a lapse carries no reinstatement fee, because the fee arises only for a reinstatement with a lapse.
